topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Oh gosh, I can't believe what you found up there! Must have been a complete surprise, right? All those dusty, forgotten things left behind by the old folks. What did you find, exactly? Anything weird or maybe even valuable? I'm trying not to picture a creepy doll or old, moldy books, but it's hard not to. The attic always seemed like a time capsule, you know? You should be careful up there, though. Breathing in all that dust can't be good for you. And watch out for weak spots in the floor! I'm thinking maybe you could call someone to take a look if you're not sure what to do with it all. Just... please be careful, okay? I don't want anything to happen to you while you're exploring. Let me know what you decide!
